label: Events Landing Page
description: Landing page for events such as World Forums, conferences and live experiences.

components.label: Secondary Navigation
components.description: Navigation bar anchored below the global header, providing in-page or section-level navigation links.
components.note: Agent generates nav item labels only. URLs and structure are set by the publisher.

fields.label: Nav Item Label
fields.hint: Short, scannable label. No punctuation. Examples: Overview, Agenda, Speakers, Register.

fields.label: Nav Item URL
fields.hint: Set by publisher. Agent does not generate URLs.

components.label: Hero Marquee
components.description: Full-width hero component placed at the top of the page. Sets the visual and editorial tone of the page. Contains a heading block with title and primary CTA, plus a visual asset.
components.note: Agent generates all text fields. Image and video assets are provided by the publisher.

fields.label: Hero Title
fields.hint: Impact statement that communicates the core value or theme of the event. No full stop. Active voice. Derived from the event title and description.

fields.label: Primary CTA Label
fields.hint: Action-oriented label. No filler words. Examples: Register Now, Save Your Spot, Learn More.

fields.label: Primary CTA URL
fields.hint: Set by publisher. Agent does not generate URLs.

components.label: Section Heading Block
components.description: Standalone heading block used to introduce a page section.

fields.label: Section Title
fields.hint: Clear and direct section title. No punctuation at the end. Derived from event objectives.

components.label: Universal Group
components.description: Flexible container used to group and lay out cards in a structured grid.
components.note: Structural container — agent does not generate content here directly.

components.label: Card
components.description: Content card used to highlight a speaker, topic, session or key information item.

fields.label: Card Title
fields.hint: Concise title for the card item. No punctuation at the end.

fields.label: Card Description
fields.hint: One to two sentences of context. Plain language. Aligned with audience needs and pain points.

components.label: Content Block
components.description: Rich text block for body copy and descriptive paragraphs within a section.

fields.label: Body Copy
fields.hint: Informative paragraph aligned with the event description and objectives. Conversational but professional tone.

universal.label: Localization Required
universal.hint: Target language and region for content generation.

templateSpecific.label: Title
templateSpecific.hint: Official name of the event or page. Primary reference throughout generation.

templateSpecific.label: Description
templateSpecific.hint: General description of the event. Provides context for all generated content.

templateSpecific.label: Objectives
templateSpecific.hint: What the event aims to achieve. Informs tone and direction of CTAs and section headings.

templateSpecific.label: Success Metrics
templateSpecific.hint: How success will be measured. Used to calibrate urgency and focus of generated copy.

templateSpecific.label: Reason for Go-live Date
templateSpecific.hint: Context for the go-live deadline. May indicate event date or campaign timing.

templateSpecific.label: Target Audience
templateSpecific.hint: Who the page is for. Used to calibrate tone, vocabulary and relevance of generated content.

templateSpecific.label: Audience Needs & Pain Points
templateSpecific.hint: What the audience is struggling with or looking for. Makes content resonate and feel relevant.

templateSpecific.label: Business Justification
templateSpecific.hint: Why this page matters to the business. Provides strategic context for content decisions.

templateSpecific.label: Additional Context
templateSpecific.hint: Any additional information the author wants the agent to consider. Free-form input not covered by other fields.
